title: Binance Margin Introduces the Margin Call Ratio Customization and Margin Call Alert Frequency Adjustment
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, To improve user experience through the inclusion of smarter risk management tools, Binance Margin is thrilled to announce that the Margin Call Ratio Customization and Margin Call Alert Frequency feature are now online. Key Highlights: Customization of Margin Call Ratio Users can now set their preferred Margin Call Ratio to align with their risk management framework. When the Margin Level drops to their customized Margin Call Ratio, users will receive the alert through both email and SMS. Adjustment of Margin Call Alert Frequency Binance Margin now allows users to set the alert frequency at intervals of 1 hour, 4 hours, 12 hours and 24 hours. With this new feature, users can stay informed without experiencing unnecessary interruptions. For More Information How to Set the Customized Margin Call Ratio and Alert Frequency on Binance Margin Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-19
